List live broadcasts. Use this tool to list live broadcasts for the authenticated user.

Usage:
  yutu liveBroadcast list [flags]

Examples:
# List my live broadcasts
yutu liveBroadcast list --mine
# List live broadcasts by ID
yutu liveBroadcast list --ids broadcast1,broadcast2
# List active live broadcasts
yutu liveBroadcast list --mine --broadcastStatus active --output json

Flags:
  -s, --broadcastStatus string                 Broadcast status filter (all, active, upcoming, completed)
  -T, --broadcastType string                   Broadcast type filter (all, event, persistent)
  -h, --help                                   help for list
  -i, --ids strings                            Return live broadcasts with the given ids
  -n, --maxResults int                         The maximum number of items that should be returned, 0 for no limit (default 5)
  -m, --mine                                   List broadcasts owned by the authenticated user
  -b, --onBehalfOfContentOwner string          ID of the content owner, for YouTube content partners
  -B, --onBehalfOfContentOwnerChannel string   Channel ID for content owner operations
  -o, --output string                          json|yaml|table (default "table")
  -p, --parts strings                          Comma separated parts (default [id,snippet,status])
